No.14020/1/88-Estt.(D)
Government of India
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
Department of Personnel & Training
Estt.(D) Section

Subject:- Recruitment to the grade of Lower Division
Clerk-Proficiency in typewriting-Question of
recognition of tests held under the Hindi
Teaching Scheme.

The undersigned is directed to say that instructions
were issued vide this Department's O.M.No.14020/5/79-Estt.(D)
dated 20th September, 1979, to the effect that as the
typing test under the Hindi Teaching Scheme was not designed
to test the speed of the candidates in Hindi typewriting,
it cannot be recognised as equivalent to a pass in typing
test in Hindi held by the Staff Selection Commission at
25 w.p.m. for the purposes of regularisation of the
appointment as LDC/grant of increments. The typing test
conducted under the above scheme has undergone a major
change w.e.f. 23.3.1985 and the employee is now required
to qualify at 25 w.p.m. A mention to this effect is also
made in the certificates issued by the Department of Official
Language. It has, therefore, been decided that w.e.f.
23.3.1985 the certificate in typewriting issued under the
Hindi Teaching Scheme would be treated as equivalent to the
certificate issued by the Staff Selection Commission for
purposes of regularisation of LDCs/drawal of increments
etc. Necessary amendments to the recruitment rules
may be made accordingly, wherever necessary.

2. The Ministries of Agriculture & Cooperation etc.
are requested to bring these instructions to the notice of
all concerned attached and subordinate Offices for their
guidance.

All Ministries/Departments of the Government of India.

All Attached Offices of Department of Personnel and
Training.
